tests.command: pnpm exec vitest run focused P02-07 metric, filter, comparison and column suites
focused market-pools, by-token and user-preferences API suites
focused pool stream and comparison snapshot/diff suites
desktop/mobile screenshots, keyboard, focus, overflow and axe assertions

assumptions: Evidence is local-fixture-verified only; POOL-05, POOL-06 and POOL-11 remain implemented-assumed.
BSC chainId 56 is the only implemented chain; every other chain remains unclaimed.
Fee/TVL is unannualized Fees divided by TVL for the current window and is null when either input is missing or TVL is not positive.
aTVL and Fee/aTVL remain unresolved and null; neither is inferred or replaced with zero.
Pool comparison selection remains session-only and binds every selected row to one window, snapshot version and as-of time.
POOL-07, POOL-12 through POOL-15, STATS-01 and STATS-02 remain planned; labels, candles, ticks, business context actions, blocking and creator attribution are not implemented.
P02-01 through P02-06 acceptance directories remain byte-identical to the pre-P02-07 hash list.
No external RPC, metadata fetch, price fetch, production secret, signature, broadcast, funds operation or new chain sample is used.
